name: devdigest/run-plan
summary: Execute an already-approved implementation plan (docs/plans/<feature>.md) fully autonomously and bring the feature to a review-ready state: implementer agents (multi-agent by DAG, or single), architecture-reviewer, pr-self-review and plan-verifier in parallel, then a bounded fix loop that re-reviews only changed files. Never commits or pushes. Manual invocation only: /run-plan plan:<path> [mode:single|multi] [max-fix:N].
